title: hub-relay-group-list
description: The shared list of relay groups a client offers (Lights, Appliances, USB, ...), in the order it lists them. Published retained by the hub plugin to renewvan/hub/relay-group-list, restored from the value it persisted on the Pi and published on every (re)connect; until the first command it is the five stock groups ["Lights", "Appliances", "USB", "Water", "Heating"]. Changed by a client sending the same payload, unretained, to renewvan/hub/relay-group-list/set, which replaces the whole list; a client never writes the state topic. Up to 16 distinct names of 1 to 32 characters with no leading or trailing whitespace; an empty array is valid. The name 'Unassigned' stands for the relays with no group: where it sits in the list is where a consumer draws them (last when it is absent). The plugin does not change the assignments (hub-relay-groups.schema.json) when a name leaves the list: a consumer reads an assignment to a name that is not in the list as Unassigned.
